reportContents: Measured issuer, URL, licence, file/row/column counts, dictionary file/hash and coverage.

countQualification.scope: Column instances across retained files, not independent positives; SF's two similar designs count once.
countQualification.documented: Only non-empty verbatim column descriptions count. Dataset-level geometry text is separate.
countQualification.undocumentedFootprints: New Orleans and Edmonton each have zero column definitions; not unknown or estimated.
countQualification.missingLicence: A null licence in families.json means no licence statement in retained publisher metadata.
countQualification.reason: Most documented fields are energy metrics. No qualified six-target audit or labels were made.
countQualification.notSubstituted: Counts are not storey literals; building use is not unit type; keys are not registrations.

restart.selfReview: Task-root validation alone admitted credential filenames; guard and no-read regression added.
restart.cause: Interrupted pending issuer/CRS corrections left the manifest, registry and catalogue pins inconsistent.
restart.fix: Refresh only owned registry/catalogue/pin metadata and preserve all original receipts and bytes.

profileCoverage.cause: WKT replacement expansion occurs after T1's 256-character truncation and exceeds the schema limit.
profileCoverage.policy: No input clipping, feature variants, geometry repair, masking/backend/contract edits or labels.
profileCoverage.reproduction: --check now asserts equality of existing profiles, links, dictionary rows and inventories.

heldOut.policy: Counts come from existing public evidence. Reuse D8 development checks only; never its private main().
heldOut.historicalCheck: The prior session ran the full count-output verifier; this continuation does not repeat it.
